# `assets/humanoid/HumanoidRig.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/humanoid/HumanoidRig.js`

engine/assets/humanoid/HumanoidRig.js — canonical humanoid bone slots + rig schema (spec §12). A humanoid is NOT its skeleton: it's a mapping from the source skeleton's bones onto a canonical slot set (Unity Mecanim / VRM style) plus rest-pose + correction metadata, so animation can retarget and physics can build a ragdoll regardless of how the artist named or oriented the rig. Every mapping is a HINT with confidence; unmapped/ambiguous bones go to the editor.

## Functions

### `createHumanoidRig(init = {})`

Create a humanoid rig descriptor.

**Parameters:**

- `init` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

### `boneSide(slot)`

Is a canonical slot a left/right limb (vs a center/spine bone)?

### `mirrorBone(slot)`

The mirrored slot for a left/right bone (e.g. leftHand ↔ rightHand), or null.
